review_kind: AI-reviewed translation (Claude, direct exact-source translation and technical self-review); no native-speaker signoff
review: Item 560 DINOv2 drop-in: the DINO choice, its in-use line and the annotated cell example. Preserve DINOv2, Cell-DINO, ViT-S/14, Meta, the 'infected' column name and all placeholders; {button}, {embed}, {classifier} and {run} are filled with the existing translated control captions. The example cells show the workflow only and are not a scientific comparison.
